audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Quinn levels 2, 3, 6 and the 2-item stage on a 48.13% matchup whose own prose says Camille takes over from 4 onward.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Quinn, Skill, Camille, Camille, Camille, Camille, Skill; whys[2]-[5] and mid/late all describe Camille winning those stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names attached to the wrong slots — 'W (Hextech Ultimatum cone)', 'E (Hextech Ultimatum hookshot)' — plus an invented 'Vulnerable W execute', and the page claimed the blind makes her W cone whiff.
audit.why: W is Tactical Sweep, a delayed cone that slows and heals her off the outer half; E is Hookshot; R is The Hextech Ultimatum. A blind hinders basic attacks, so it does nothing to a cone — but Precision Protocol (Q) IS an empowered basic attack, so the blind eats it outright. That is the interaction the page was missing while it named the wrong ones.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, whys[5], early, wants.foe[0], report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now state Precision-Protocol-is-an-auto and drop the invented execute.

audit.why: Hookshot 16/15/14/13/12 and it pulls to a wall — in open lane she has no engage at all.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are mine. I out-range her at 1 and a Harrier-marked auto plus Q (Blinding Assault) chunks her before her E hookshot exists to answer me. At 2-3 I can Vault (E) in for a Harrier reset, blind her so her W cone auto whiffs, and kite back on Heightened Senses (W) speed. The thing to dodge is her E wall-dash engage — if she has no wall and no E up, every trade is free for me.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are mine. I out-range her at 1 and a Harrier-marked auto plus Q (Blinding Assault) chunks her before Hookshot exists to answer me. At 2-3 I Vault (E) in for a Harrier reset and blind her — Precision Protocol is an empowered basic attack, so the blind eats it outright — then kite back on Heightened Senses speed. Hookshot needs a wall: no wall, no engage, every trade free.

notes: The Camille-side audit deliberately left this chart untouched and pushed it to the user; I re-cut Quinn's side to the packet chart because the packet is the shared source both pages derive from and Quinn's own prose already reads that way.
